summary: The implementation covers most of the BuildRequest requirements. Team signup form, merch shop, shopping cart, and admin dashboard are all implemented with appropriate Motoko backend and React frontend. Gaming-focused visual theme with dark colors and aggressive styling is present. However, there is a missing critical piece: admin functionality to approve/reject applications is not implemented. The diff contains file truncations which limits full verification, but based on visible evidence, the core features are largely complete.

missing_requirements.requirement: Admin can approve or reject applications
missing_requirements.reason: AdminSignupList component only displays submitted applications in a read-only table format. No UI controls (buttons, actions) for approving or rejecting applications are visible in the component. The backend also lacks any methods for application approval/rejection.

hallucinated_features.description: User profile system with name and gamer tag
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest does not mention creating user profiles separate from team signup. The implementation includes UserProfile type, profile modal (ProfileSetupModal.tsx), and profile management methods (getCallerUserProfile, saveCallerUserProfile) that were not requested.
